title: Reported by dc's agents and not re-driven: edit's paths and refusals, an Immutable field that accepts a set, a raw sqlite lock
body:
Reported by dc's agents, not yet re-driven; re-drive each before fixing:

- `intent edit <ac address> --path` returns info.md, but the criterion renders in acceptance.md.
- The `edit wp` remedy names `intent wp`, which has no body writer.
- The `edit` kind refusal offers `issue`, then refuses it.
- `intent set ... acceptance exempt` succeeds, though `transitions.rs` declares the field Immutable.
- A losing concurrent write surfaces a raw `sqlite: database is locked`.
- The generated info.md Acceptance paragraph routes readers to hand-edit canon plus `sync --to-store`, as if the verbs did not exist.

Found by hv's estate-wide doc audit of 2026-09-11 (the audit's orders are in `intent/history/20260911-doc-audit.md`), where it is described as built. Carried in `intent/wip.md` as an unruled defect until 2026-09-13, when that file was leaned and every open defect became an issue. Not worked until hv rules it; a ruled one gets a lane.

**CLOSED 2026-09-15, landed on vc's word with 0396 in the same commit.** Each bullet above was re-driven before it was fixed, and each fix follows vc's reading of 2026-09-14, which hv's rulings of 2026-09-15 let stand (item 15). An ac/at address resolves to the generated `acceptance.md` and refuses naming `intent ac` and `intent at`. `edit wp`'s remedy names `intent set intent:///threads/<ST>/wp/<NN> objective|body --from <file>`. `issue` leaves `edit`'s kind roster and `edit issue <id>` names `intent issues edit <id>`, while `browse` keeps it. The generated covers' Acceptance paragraphs name the `intent ac` and `intent at` verbs. The raw sqlite lock is issue 0376's, closed. **The Immutable field is NOT fixed here:** refusing `set` on `Thread.acceptance` would leave the close gate's remedy naming a declaration no verb writes, so vc withdrew that reading to issue 0400, whose patch is kept at `refs/bank/ic/0334-4`.
